pylons_en: 2 yellow arch pylons leaning toward the river, 89 m; red steel deck

model3d.notes: 200 m main span, 89 m pylons, 48 stays (24 per pylon, so 6 per side per plane assuming 2 planes), steel deck 21 m (CafeF). Side spans not published (estimated 90 m). Pylon form read from the CafeF and VTC photos (7/2025).

pylon_custom.description: Each pylon is a yellow arch: two legs straddle the red steel deck and curve together at the top, the arch bowing forward toward the main span. Below the deck each leg sweeps outward in a curved yellow 'wing' foot to the pier; a curved strut also reaches out under the side-span deck. Two planes of stays fan to the deck edges on both sides.

colour: yellow pylons, red steel deck edge girders, white stays
